references.title: Garden Fertilizer Basics
references.evidence_boundary: General plant nutrition guidance, not an experimentally established Cannabis minimal medium, exact structure mapping, stoichiometric uptake requirement or concentration prescription.

model_implications: Do not infer that a mineral is dispensable merely because the present metabolite certificates show zero net consumption.
Account separately for catalytic, structural and growth-related mineral requirements.
An atmospheric N2-consuming catalog route is not evidence that Cannabis directly assimilates N2; require explicit organism and reaction support.
The selenium-containing inventory needs selenium input for elemental balance, but that is distinct from selenium being an essential nutrient for ordinary plant growth.
Keep CO2, water, gas exchange, proton balance and light/energy separately typed from mineral nutrient ingredients.
Resolve exact uptake forms, counterions and assimilation reactions before a numerical minimum-medium test; do not map nutrient element names directly onto arbitrary compounds containing that element.
